theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_cutoff_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (f : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (c R A τ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ t, c ≤ t → φ t = 0) → 0 < c → 0 < τ → c * τ < R → AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |f x| ≤ A) → Integrable (fun x ↦ f x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ)) μ ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ f x * (-(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ))) μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ ∫ x, f x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / t) ∂μ) (∫ x, f x * (-(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ)) ∂μ) τ
